scope: Examines how consumer technology and media habits, activities, expectations, and shopping behavior changed during COVID-19 shelter-in-place and what may persist after reopening, with an actionable post-COVID-19 agenda for technology and media companies. Research coverage is primarily U.S. consumer data across technology, internet, media, and entertainment; studies cited are from April and May 2020, and the report is dated June 10, 2020.
